description: Removes one of your own UNPUBLISHED sites from your account so it no longer appears in list_sites (for example test sites). Nothing is deleted: it is the same recoverable archive the dashboard uses. Live sites, and sites with an active client pay link, are refused. Signed-in accounts only. Free.

site_key.description: The site to archive. Must be yours and NOT published (a live site is refused).

name: archive_site
title: Archive an unpublished site
